text.content:
A drowned town under poisoned water.

Region: The Outskirts. Was: Laguna Reservoir (2045)
Controlled by: NC Dam Ltd at the dam; nobody on the shore
The feel of it: A church spire under the surface on a still day
Notable locations: Laguna Bend Dam, the Drowned Town, the Shoreline camps
Danger: Outskirts. SC 1. UC 10. Don't swim

NC Dam Ltd flooded the valley and the township of Laguna Bend in 2062. The water is toxic, and will be for years, so the city drinks the sea instead.

Places

  • Laguna Bend Dam. SC 7: NC Dam Ltd Security. Concrete and turbines. The power plant runs; the water purification plant was never finished.
  • The Drowned Town. SC 1. Divers go down in hazmat suits for salvage. The streets are still visible on a clear day.
  • The Shoreline. SC 2. Squatter camps along the old shore, where nomads pushed out of Rancho Coronado now live.

Night City 2070 (The Unification Era), ch.01, 13
